pack.name: Brotherhood of the Fire Fist
pack.blurb: The Fire Fist: FIRE Beast-Warriors who Set Fire Formation Spells and Traps straight from the Deck, then burn them for power. Tiger King, Cardinal and Kirin lead the brotherhood.

deck.name: Brotherhood of the Fire Fist
deck.cover: Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Tiger King
deck.blurb: Bear and Rooster set a Formation, send it away to break a card, and set the next one. Every Formation makes the brothers stronger, and two of them make a Tiger King.

npc.intro: Fists up. The Brotherhood is in town!
lines_add: And on the hot days I fight with the Fire Fist. Three decks, one me.
